answer: Problem: Sybil swarms mint disposable agents that dilute peer weight overnight. Mechanism: a new identity seals one marble-capped capability receipt inside a signed trust voyage—three established peers countersign a 72-hour path binding a single kernel hash of its device key to one stake slot. Cost: 25 POA locked for 2 epochs plus 2 POA per voucher. Verification: explorers reject kernel reuse or mismatched voyage ids. Failure: any countersigner revoke before finality burns the slot and resets weight to zero.
